scope: federal, statewide, and legislative (State Senate and State House) only; no local, county, judicial retention, or ballot-issue contests

certification.note: The official SOS 2022 General results page posts the official results workbook but does not include a State Canvassing Board minutes PDF (the filename used in 2024 and 2026 returned 404). Contemporary reporting in the Wyoming Tribune Eagle states the board met Wednesday, November 16, 2022 and voted unanimously to certify the results, making them official. The meeting had been publicly noticed for that date and time.
